name: arcade
description: Offline game collection, as a website, installable web app and native app

scripts.android: node tools/build.js --www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node tools/build.js --www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: node tools/build.js --www && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
